Ivy N.: Quick note from support: Go generator sample doesn't stop on ctx cancel sometimes. Repro: start generator, read one token, cancel -> Next() blocks.

Ivy N.: Minimal repro:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
iter, _ := client.Generator(ctx, req)
_, _ = iter.Next()
cancel()
// Next() can hang
```

Carlos P.: Which transport? http?

Ivy N.: net/http in sample. Looks like auth retry reopens stream; old reader goroutine hangs on Read().

Sam T.: Parity issue vs node/py. Short-term: update sample to `defer iter.Close()` and show `select { case <-ctx.Done(): iter.Close(); return }` in loop. Long-term: SDK should implement io.Closer on iterator and cancel internal request context on Close().

Carlos P.: Also: avoid auto-retry for streaming calls. Add per-call flag `NoStreamRetry:true` or default no-retry for streams. That prevents reopen races.

Sam T.: Agreed. I'll add Close(), map Close -> context.Canceled for in-flight Next(), and add unit test that asserts Next() returns within ~100ms after Close().

Ivy N.: Can we add a CI regression that snapshots runtime.NumGoroutine() before/after Close() to catch leaks? New users keep hitting this in onboarding.

Sam T.: Yes. Also capture follow-ups: expose BufferTokens option for backpressure and consider an opt-in NextWithCtx(ctx) API for per-call timeouts.

ops-bot: Created issue #2600: "go-sdk: generator stream cancel + transport retry race" and linked draft PRs.

Carlos P.: I'll update Quickstart blurb with the cancel/Close guidance. Ivy, can you paste your sample repro into the issue?

Ivy N.: Done. Will follow up with PR link for sample-app changes. Thanks!
